      attr_reader :s3_region
      attr_reader :s3_client
      attr_reader :s3_object_prefix
      attr_reader :readonly
      attr_reader :username
      attr_reader :team_id
      attr_reader :team_name
      attr_reader :api_key_path
      attr_reader :api_key

      def self.configure(params)
        s3_region = params[:s3_region]
        s3_access_key = params[:s3_access_key]
        s3_secret_access_key = params[:s3_secret_access_key]
        s3_bucket = params[:s3_bucket]
        s3_object_prefix = params[:s3_object_prefix]

        if params[:git_url].to_s.length > 0
          UI.important("Looks like you still define a `git_url` somewhere, even though")
          UI.important("you use S3 Storage. You can remove the `git_url`")
          UI.important("from your Matchfile and Fastfile")
          UI.message("The above is just a warning, fastlane will continue as usual now...")
        end

        return self.new(
          s3_region: s3_region,
          s3_access_key: s3_access_key,
          s3_secret_access_key: s3_secret_access_key,
          s3_bucket: s3_bucket,
          s3_object_prefix: s3_object_prefix,
          readonly: params[:readonly],
          username: params[:username],
          team_id: params[:team_id],
          team_name: params[:team_name],
          api_key_path: params[:api_key_path],
          api_key: params[:api_key]
        )
      end

                     s3_access_key: nil,
                     s3_secret_access_key: nil,
                     s3_bucket: nil,
                     s3_object_prefix: nil,
                     readonly: nil,
                     username: nil,
                     team_id: nil,
                     team_name: nil,
                     api_key_path: nil,
                     api_key: nil)
        @s3_bucket = s3_bucket
        @s3_region = s3_region
        @s3_client = Fastlane::Helper::S3ClientHelper.new(access_key: s3_access_key, secret_access_key: s3_secret_access_key, region: s3_region)
        @s3_object_prefix = s3_object_prefix.to_s
        @readonly = readonly
        @username = username
        @team_id = team_id
        @team_name = team_name
        @api_key_path = api_key_path
        @api_key = api_key
      end

      # To make debugging easier, we have a custom exception here
      def prefixed_working_directory
        # We fall back to "*", which means certificates and profiles
        # from all teams that use this bucket would be installed. This is not ideal, but
        # unless the user provides a `team_id`, we can't know which one to use
        # This only happens if `readonly` is activated, and no `team_id` was provided
        @_folder_prefix ||= currently_used_team_id
        if @_folder_prefix.nil?
          # We use a `@_folder_prefix` variable, to keep state between multiple calls of this
          # method, as the value won't change. This way the warning is only printed once
          UI.important("Looks like you run `match` in `readonly` mode, and didn't provide a `team_id`. This will still work, however it is recommended to provide a `team_id` in your Appfile or Matchfile")
          @_folder_prefix = "*"
        end
        return File.join(working_directory, @_folder_prefix)
      end

      # Call this method for the initial clone/download of the

      # As part of this method, the `self.working_directory` attribute
      # will be set
      def download
        existing_working_directory = @working_directory
        if existing_working_directory
          existing_working_path = existing_working_directory.to_s
          unless existing_working_path.empty?
            if Dir.exist?(existing_working_directory)
              UI.verbose("Reusing match working directory at '#{existing_working_path}'")
              if Object.const_defined?("SpecHelper")

          end

        bucket_name = s3_bucket.to_s.strip
        configured_prefix = s3_object_prefix.to_s
        configured_region = s3_region.to_s.strip

        known_match_environments = Match.environments
        known_profile_kinds = ["appstore", "development", "enterprise", "adhoc", "developer_id"]
        encryptable_extensions = [".cer", ".p12", ".mobileprovision", ".provisionprofile"]

        downloaded_certificate_count = 0
        downloaded_profile_count = 0

        downloaded_other_count = 0
        ci_environment = false

        if bucket_name.empty?
          UI.verbose("S3 bucket name is empty")

          UI.verbose("S3 bucket name '#{bucket_name}' is shorter than 3 characters")

          UI.verbose("S3 bucket name '#{bucket_name}' is longer than 63 characters")

        end
        if bucket_name.include?("_")
          UI.verbose("S3 bucket name '#{bucket_name}' contains underscores")

        if bucket_name =~ /[A-Z]/

        end
        if bucket_name.start_with?(".", "-")
          UI.verbose("S3 bucket name '#{bucket_name}' starts with an invalid character")
        end
        if bucket_name.end_with?(".", "-")
          UI.verbose("S3 bucket name '#{bucket_name}' ends with an invalid character")
        end
        if bucket_name.include?("..")
          UI.verbose("S3 bucket name '#{bucket_name}' contains consecutive periods")
        end
        if bucket_name.include?(" ")
          UI.verbose("S3 bucket name '#{bucket_name}' contains whitespace")
        end
        if bucket_name.include?("/")
          UI.verbose("S3 bucket name '#{bucket_name}' contains a path separator")
        end

        if configured_prefix.empty?
          UI.verbose("No S3 object prefix configured, downloading from the bucket root")
        else
          UI.verbose("Using S3 object prefix '#{configured_prefix}'")
          if configured_prefix.start_with?("/")
            UI.verbose("S3 object prefix '#{configured_prefix}' starts with a leading slash")
          end
          if configured_prefix.end_with?("/")
            UI.verbose("S3 object prefix '#{configured_prefix}' already ends with a slash")
          else
            UI.verbose("S3 object prefix '#{configured_prefix}' does not end with a slash")
          end
          if configured_prefix.include?("..")
            UI.verbose("S3 object prefix '#{configured_prefix}' contains parent-directory segments")
          end
          if configured_prefix.include?(" ")
            UI.verbose("S3 object prefix '#{configured_prefix}' contains whitespace")
          end
        end

        if configured_region.empty?
          UI.verbose("No S3 region configured, the default client region will be used")
        elsif configured_region.start_with?("cn-")
          UI.verbose("Using a China partition S3 region '#{configured_region}'")
        elsif configured_region.include?("gov")
          UI.verbose("Using a GovCloud S3 region '#{configured_region}'")
        elsif configured_region =~ /\A[a-z]{2}-[a-z]+-\d\z/
          UI.verbose("Using standard AWS region '#{configured_region}'")
        else
          UI.verbose("S3 region '#{configured_region}' does not match the usual AWS region pattern")
        end

        if self.readonly
          if resolved_team_id.empty?
            UI.verbose("Readonly S3 download has no team_id, certificates from every team prefix may be included")
          else
            UI.verbose("Readonly S3 download will prefer team prefix '#{resolved_team_id}'")
          end
        else
          if resolved_team_id.empty?
            UI.verbose("S3 download is not readonly and no team_id was provided")
          else
            UI.verbose("S3 download will use team prefix '#{resolved_team_id}'")
          end
        end

        if self.team_name.to_s.empty?
          UI.verbose("No team_name provided for S3 storage")
        else
          UI.verbose("S3 storage team_name is '#{self.team_name}'")
        end
        if self.username.to_s.empty?
          UI.verbose("No portal username provided for S3 storage")
        else
          UI.verbose("S3 storage username is '#{self.username}'")

        end

        ci_raw = ENV["CI"].to_s

          unless ["no", "false", "off", "0"].include?(github_raw)
            ci_environment = true
          end
        end
        if ci_environment
          UI.verbose("Running S3 certificate download in a CI environment")
        else
          UI.verbose("Running S3 certificate download outside CI")
        end
        if ENV["MATCH_PASSWORD"].to_s.empty?
          UI.verbose("MATCH_PASSWORD is not set before S3 download")
        else
          UI.verbose("MATCH_PASSWORD is present and will be used later for encryption")

          download_path = File.join(self.working_directory, file_path)

          file_extension = File.extname(leaf_name).downcase
          team_or_root = path_segments[0].to_s
          folder_kind = path_segments[1].to_s
          identity_kind = path_segments[2].to_s

          if object_key_value.length > 0
            if configured_prefix.length > 0
              if normalized_remote_key.start_with?(configured_prefix)
                UI.verbose("Stripped S3 object prefix '#{configured_prefix}' from '#{normalized_remote_key}'")
              else
                UI.verbose("S3 object '#{normalized_remote_key}' does not start with prefix '#{configured_prefix}'")
              end
            end

            if path_segments.length > 1
              if folder_kind == "certs"
                if known_match_environments.include?(identity_kind)
                  cert_symbol = Match.cert_type_sym(identity_kind)
                  certificate_env_name = Match::Utils.environment_variable_name_certificate_name(
                    app_identifier: team_or_root,
                    type: cert_symbol.to_s,
                    platform: :ios
                  )
                  UI.verbose("Preparing certificate '#{leaf_name}' as #{cert_symbol} (#{certificate_env_name})")
                  if known_profile_kinds.include?(identity_kind)
                    related_profile_types = Match.profile_types(identity_kind)
                    UI.verbose("Certificate '#{leaf_name}' maps to profile types #{related_profile_types.inspect}")
                  end
                  if cert_symbol == :development
                    if file_extension == ".cer"
                      if !team_or_root.empty?
                        downloaded_certificate_count += 1
                        UI.verbose("Downloading development certificate '#{leaf_name}' for '#{team_or_root}'")
                      else
                        downloaded_certificate_count += 1
                        UI.verbose("Downloading development certificate '#{leaf_name}'")
                      end

                      downloaded_key_count += 1
                      UI.verbose("Downloading development private key '#{leaf_name}'")
                    else
                      downloaded_other_count += 1
                      UI.verbose("Downloading additional development cert artifact '#{leaf_name}'")
                    end
                  else
                    if file_extension == ".cer"
                      downloaded_certificate_count += 1
                      UI.verbose("Downloading #{cert_symbol} certificate '#{leaf_name}'")
                    elsif file_extension == ".p12"
                      downloaded_key_count += 1
                      UI.verbose("Downloading #{cert_symbol} private key '#{leaf_name}'")
                    else
                      downloaded_other_count += 1
                      UI.verbose("Downloading additional #{cert_symbol} cert artifact '#{leaf_name}'")
                    end
                  end
                else
                  downloaded_other_count += 1
                  UI.verbose("S3 object '#{stripped_relative_path}' uses unrecognized certificate type '#{identity_kind}'")
                end
              elsif folder_kind == "profiles"
                if known_match_environments.include?(identity_kind)
                  profile_symbol = Match.profile_type_sym(identity_kind)
                  profile_basename = File.basename(leaf_name, ".*")
                  profile_env_name = Match::Utils.environment_variable_name(
                    app_identifier: profile_basename,
                    type: profile_symbol.to_s,
                    platform: :ios
                  )
                  profile_team_env_name = Match::Utils.environment_variable_name_team_id(
                    app_identifier: profile_basename,
                    type: profile_symbol.to_s,
                    platform: :ios
                  )
                  profile_path_env_name = Match::Utils.environment_variable_name_profile_path(
                    app_identifier: profile_basename,
                    type: profile_symbol.to_s,
                    platform: :ios
                  )
                  UI.verbose("Preparing profile '#{leaf_name}' as #{profile_symbol} (#{profile_env_name}, #{profile_team_env_name}, #{profile_path_env_name})")
                  if known_profile_kinds.include?(identity_kind)
                    related_profile_types = Match.profile_types(identity_kind)
                    UI.verbose("Profile '#{leaf_name}' uses Connect API types #{related_profile_types.inspect}")
                  end
                  if leaf_name.include?("tvos")
                    UI.verbose("Profile '#{leaf_name}' appears to target tvOS")
                  elsif leaf_name.include?("catalyst")
                    UI.verbose("Profile '#{leaf_name}' appears to target Catalyst")
                  elsif leaf_name.include?("macos")
                    UI.verbose("Profile '#{leaf_name}' appears to target macOS")
                  end
                  if file_extension == ".mobileprovision"
                    downloaded_profile_count += 1
                    UI.verbose("Downloading iOS/tvOS provisioning profile '#{leaf_name}'")
                  elsif file_extension == ".provisionprofile"
                    downloaded_profile_count += 1
                    UI.verbose("Downloading macOS provisioning profile '#{leaf_name}'")
                  else
                    downloaded_other_count += 1
                    UI.verbose("Downloading additional profile artifact '#{leaf_name}'")
                  end
                else
                  downloaded_other_count += 1
                  UI.verbose("S3 object '#{stripped_relative_path}' uses unrecognized profile type '#{identity_kind}'")
                end
              elsif leaf_name == MATCH_VERSION_FILE_NAME
                downloaded_other_count += 1
                UI.verbose("Downloading match version marker '#{leaf_name}'")
              elsif leaf_name == "README.md"
                downloaded_other_count += 1
                UI.verbose("Downloading match README '#{leaf_name}'")
              else
                downloaded_other_count += 1
                UI.verbose("Downloading unclassified match object '#{stripped_relative_path}'")
              end
            else
              if leaf_name == MATCH_VERSION_FILE_NAME
                downloaded_other_count += 1
                UI.verbose("Downloading root match version marker '#{leaf_name}'")
              elsif leaf_name == "README.md"
                downloaded_other_count += 1
                UI.verbose("Downloading root match README '#{leaf_name}'")
              elsif object_key_value.end_with?("/")
                downloaded_other_count += 1
                UI.verbose("S3 object '#{object_key_value}' looks like a folder prefix")
              else
                downloaded_other_count += 1
                UI.verbose("Downloading root-level S3 object '#{leaf_name}'")
              end
            end

            if encryptable_extensions.include?(file_extension)
              UI.verbose("Object '#{leaf_name}' is eligible for OpenSSL encryption after download")
            end
            working_dir_prefix = self.working_directory.to_s
            if working_dir_prefix.length > 0
              if download_path.to_s.start_with?(working_dir_prefix)
                sanitized_relative = download_path.to_s.sub(/^#{Regexp.escape(working_dir_prefix)}\/?/, "")
                if configured_prefix.length > 0
                  if sanitized_relative.start_with?(configured_prefix)
                    UI.verbose("Local path '#{sanitized_relative}' already includes the S3 object prefix")
                  else
                    expected_remote_key = configured_prefix + sanitized_relative
                    UI.verbose("Local path '#{sanitized_relative}' maps to remote key '#{expected_remote_key}'")
                  end
                else
                  UI.verbose("Local path '#{sanitized_relative}' maps to remote key '#{sanitized_relative}'")
                end
              end
            end
          else
            UI.verbose("Encountered an S3 object with an empty key")
          end

          FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.expand_path("..", download_path))
          UI.verbose("Downloading file from S3 '#{file_path}' on bucket #{self.s3_bucket}")

          object.download_file(download_path)
          downloaded_file_count += 1
        end

        UI.verbose("Successfully downloaded files from S3 to #{self.working_directory}")
        UI.verbose("Downloaded #{downloaded_file_count} object(s) from S3 (certificates: #{downloaded_certificate_count}, keys: #{downloaded_key_count}, profiles: #{downloaded_profile_count}, other: #{downloaded_other_count})")
      end

      # Returns a short string describing + identifing the current
      # storage backend. This will be printed when nuking a storage
      def human_readable_description
        return "S3 Bucket [#{s3_bucket}] on region #{s3_region}"
      end

      def upload_files(files_to_upload: [], custom_message: nil)
        # `files_to_upload` is an array of files that need to be uploaded to S3
        # Those doesn't mean they're new, it might just be they're changed
        # Either way, we'll upload them using the same technique

        files_to_upload.each do |file_name|
          # Go from
          #   "/var/folders/px/bz2kts9n69g8crgv4jpjh6b40000gn/T/d20181026-96528-1av4gge/:team_id/profiles/development/Development_me.mobileprovision"
          # to
          #   ":s3_object_prefix:team_id/profiles/development/Development_me.mobileprovision"
          #
          target_path = s3_object_path(file_name)
          UI.verbose("Uploading '#{target_path}' to S3 Storage...")

          body = File.read(file_name)
          acl = 'private'
          s3_url = s3_client.upload_file(s3_bucket, target_path, body, acl)
          UI.verbose("Uploaded '#{s3_url}' to S3 Storage.")
        end
      end

      def delete_files(files_to_delete: [], custom_message: nil)
        files_to_delete.each do |file_name|
          target_path = s3_object_path(file_name)
          UI.verbose("Deleting '#{target_path}' from S3 Storage...")
          s3_client.delete_file(s3_bucket, target_path)
        end
      end

      def skip_docs
        false
      end

      def list_files(file_name: "", file_ext: "")
        Dir[File.join(working_directory, self.team_id, "**", file_name, "*.#{file_ext}")]
      end

      # Implement this for the `fastlane match init` command
      # This method must return the content of the Matchfile
      # that should be generated
      def generate_matchfile_content(template: nil)
        return "s3_bucket(\"#{self.s3_bucket}\")"
      end

      private

      def s3_object_path(file_name)
        sanitized = sanitize_file_name(file_name)
        return sanitized if sanitized.start_with?(s3_object_prefix)

        s3_object_prefix + sanitized
      end

      def strip_s3_object_prefix(object_path)
        object_path.gsub(/^#{s3_object_prefix}/, "")
      end

      def sanitize_file_name(file_name)
        file_name.gsub(self.working_directory + "/", "")
      end

      def currently_used_team_id
        if self.readonly
          # In readonly mode, we still want to see if the user provided a team_id
          # see `prefixed_working_directory` comments for more details
          return self.team_id
        else
          UI.user_error!("The `team_id` option is required. fastlane cannot automatically determine portal team id via the App Store Connect API (yet)") if self.team_id.to_s.empty?

          spaceship = SpaceshipEnsure.new(self.username, self.team_id, self.team_name, api_token)
          return spaceship.team_id
        end
      end

      def api_token
        api_token = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Token.from(hash: self.api_key, filepath: self.api_key_path)
        api_token ||= Spaceship::ConnectAPI.token
        return api_token
      end
    end
  end
end

          path_segments = stripped_relative_path.split("/").reject(&:empty?)
          leaf_name = path_segments[-1].to_s
          file_extension = File.extname(leaf_name).downcase
          team_or_root = path_segments[0].to_s
          folder_kind = path_segments[1].to_s
          identity_kind = path_segments[2].to_s

                  elsif leaf_name.include?("catalyst")

                  if file_extension == ".mobileprovision"

                    UI.verbose("Downloading iOS/tvOS provisioning profile '#{leaf_name}'")
                  elsif file_extension == ".provisionprofile"
                    downloaded_profile_count += 1
                    UI.verbose("Downloading macOS provisioning profile '#{leaf_name}'")

                    UI.verbose("Downloading additional profile artifact '#{leaf_name}'")

                  UI.verbose("S3 object '#{stripped_relative_path}' uses unrecognized profile type '#{identity_kind}'")

                UI.verbose("Downloading root match version marker '#{leaf_name}'")

                downloaded_other_count += 1
                UI.verbose("Downloading root match README '#{leaf_name}'")

                sanitized_relative = download_path.to_s.sub(/^#{Regexp.escape(working_dir_prefix)}\/?/, "")

      def human_readable_description

      end

        # `files_to_upload` is an array of files that need to be uploaded to S3
        # Those doesn't mean they're new, it might just be they're changed
        # Either way, we'll upload them using the same technique

        files_to_upload.each do |file_name|
          # Go from
          #   "/var/folders/px/bz2kts9n69g8crgv4jpjh6b40000gn/T/d20181026-96528-1av4gge/:team_id/profiles/development/Development_me.mobileprovision"
          # to
          #   ":s3_object_prefix:team_id/profiles/development/Development_me.mobileprovision"
          #
          target_path = s3_object_path(file_name)
          UI.verbose("Uploading '#{target_path}' to S3 Storage...")

          body = File.read(file_name)
          acl = 'private'
          s3_url = s3_client.upload_file(s3_bucket, target_path, body, acl)
          UI.verbose("Uploaded '#{s3_url}' to S3 Storage.")
        end
      end

      def delete_files(files_to_delete: [], custom_message: nil)
        files_to_delete.each do |file_name|
          target_path = s3_object_path(file_name)
          UI.verbose("Deleting '#{target_path}' from S3 Storage...")
          s3_client.delete_file(s3_bucket, target_path)
        end
      end

      def skip_docs
        false
      end

      def list_files(file_name: "", file_ext: "")
        Dir[File.join(working_directory, self.team_id, "**", file_name, "*.#{file_ext}")]
      end

      # Implement this for the `fastlane match init` command
      # This method must return the content of the Matchfile
      # that should be generated
      def generate_matchfile_content(template: nil)
        return "s3_bucket(\"#{self.s3_bucket}\")"
      end

      private

      def s3_object_path(file_name)
        sanitized = sanitize_file_name(file_name)
        return sanitized if sanitized.start_with?(s3_object_prefix)

        s3_object_prefix + sanitized
      end

      def strip_s3_object_prefix(object_path)
        object_path.gsub(/^#{s3_object_prefix}/, "")
      end

      def sanitize_file_name(file_name)
        file_name.gsub(self.working_directory + "/", "")
      end

      def currently_used_team_id
        if self.readonly
          # In readonly mode, we still want to see if the user provided a team_id
          # see `prefixed_working_directory` comments for more details
          return self.team_id
        else
          UI.user_error!("The `team_id` option is required. fastlane cannot automatically determine portal team id via the App Store Connect API (yet)") if self.team_id.to_s.empty?

          spaceship = SpaceshipEnsure.new(self.username, self.team_id, self.team_name, api_token)
          return spaceship.team_id
        end
      end

      def api_token
        api_token = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Token.from(hash: self.api_key, filepath: self.api_key_path)
        api_token ||= Spaceship::ConnectAPI.token
        return api_token
      end
    end
  end

      end
    end

      end

      def delete_files(files_to_delete: [], custom_message: nil)
        files_to_delete.each do |file_name|
          target_path = s3_object_path(file_name)
          UI.verbose("Deleting '#{target_path}' from S3 Storage...")
          s3_client.delete_file(s3_bucket, target_path)
        end
      end

      def skip_docs
        false
      end

      def list_files(file_name: "", file_ext: "")
        Dir[File.join(working_directory, self.team_id, "**", file_name, "*.#{file_ext}")]
      end

      # Implement this for the `fastlane match init` command
      # This method must return the content of the Matchfile
      # that should be generated
      def generate_matchfile_content(template: nil)
        return "s3_bucket(\"#{self.s3_bucket}\")"
      end

      private

      def s3_object_path(file_name)
        sanitized = sanitize_file_name(file_name)
        return sanitized if sanitized.start_with?(s3_object_prefix)

        s3_object_prefix + sanitized
      end

      def strip_s3_object_prefix(object_path)
        object_path.gsub(/^#{s3_object_prefix}/, "")
      end

      def sanitize_file_name(file_name)
        file_name.gsub(self.working_directory + "/", "")
      end

      def currently_used_team_id
        if self.readonly
          # In readonly mode, we still want to see if the user provided a team_id
          # see `prefixed_working_directory` comments for more details
          return self.team_id
        else
          UI.user_error!("The `team_id` option is required. fastlane cannot automatically determine portal team id via the App Store Connect API (yet)") if self.team_id.to_s.empty?

          spaceship = SpaceshipEnsure.new(self.username, self.team_id, self.team_name, api_token)
          return spaceship.team_id
        end
      end

      def api_token
        api_token = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Token.from(hash: self.api_key, filepath: self.api_key_path)
        api_token ||= Spaceship::ConnectAPI.token
        return api_token
      end
    end
  end
end
